# routeros_queue_interface (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_queue_interface" "ether1" {
  interface = "ether1"
  queue     = "only-hardware-queue"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Name of the interface.

### Optional

- `queue` (String) Queue type to use on the interface.

### Read-Only

- `active_queue` (String) Queue type in use.
- `default_queue` (String) Queue type the interface uses by default.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/queue/interface get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_queue_interface.ether1 interface=ether1
```
